name: ColliderFromModelParams
doc: Derive a collider from an imported model or the entity's MeshRenderer selection.

fields.name: node
fields.doc: Source node name/index; omitted inherits MeshRenderer.node when model is omitted.

fields.name: primitive
fields.doc: Subtree-local primitive; omitted inherits MeshRenderer.primitive when model is omitted.

fields.name: mode
fields.doc: Convex hull by default, or a static triangle surface.

fields.name: center
fields.doc: Optional center in body-local metres, after visual scale is baked.
